ai_summary: Apollo Tyres Ltd. achieved robust consolidated revenue growth of over 16% YoY in Q2 FY27, primarily driven by strong performance in its Indian operations. However, this was significantly offset by a sharp 25% increase in raw material costs since April 2026, compressing consolidated EBITDA margins to 10.7%, alongside continued revenue decline and delayed profitability recovery in the European segment due to market weakness and restructuring challenges. Despite these operational headwinds and persistent inflationary pressures, the company maintains a strong financial position with a net debt-to-EBITDA of 0.9x.
